name: Nha Trang
provinceNote: Nha Trang is a city in Khánh Hòa. Resolution 202/2025/QH15 joins the former Ninh Thuận province into Khánh Hòa, keeps that name, and gives 8,555.86 km² and 2,243,554 people. The new provincial governments operate from 1 July 2025.
dotReason: Worth it if you are already nearby
summary: A beach city on the south-central coast, with a long city beach and a bay full of islands. Swim on the 7 km Tran Phu beach, take boat trips to the islands, visit the Cham towers of Po Nagar, and eat grilled pork rolls and clay-mould rice cakes. Two days suits beach lovers and families.
fee: No single city ticket. Po Nagar is listed at 06:00–17:30 with no ticket, and at 08:00–18:00 with 22,000 VND a person. From 6 to 11 May 2026 entry is free for the festival. Yang Bay is 120,000 VND, 250,000 VND with the mineral bath, or 390,000 VND with the mineral bath and the mud bath, and a second account lists no ticket. Beach ticket, station fare, and ride fares: Check on arrival.
getThere: Cam Ranh airport is south of the city, 27 km from the centre on the airport chart and about 30 km on the national tourism account. The train station is in the centre.
seoTitle: Nha Trang — city beach, the bay, Po Nagar, and seafood
seoDescription: Come for the seven-kilometre beach on Trần Phú, the bay and its islands, Po Nagar, and seafood. Cam Ranh is 27 km or about 30 km south. Dry months run January to August.
intro: You come for the city beach on Trần Phú, the bay and its islands, the Cham towers at Po Nagar, and the seafood. The sand runs seven kilometres in front of the hotels. Swim it by day. After dark the same shore is the walk, and the night market is the 137 m street behind 46 Trần Phú.

Stay when that beach-and-bay day is the trip. Go on to Mui Ne when the dunes and the kite are the point, or up to Da Lat when you want the hills. Po Nagar sits about 2 km north of the centre. The seated white Buddha is at Long Sơn, 22 đường 23 tháng 10. Nineteen islands fill the bay. Hòn Tre is the cable crossing, 3,320 m over the water. At Hòn Mun you snorkel or dive the coral, or take a glass-bottom boat.

Cam Ranh is 27 km from the centre, the city to the north, and about 30 km south on the national tourism account. Shuttles, taxis, and ride-hailing cover the airport. The station is in the centre. Southbound from Tuy Hòa takes 2 hours 4 minutes to 2 hours 44 minutes. Give the morning to the sand or the towers, and the evening to nem nướng, bún cá, and the walking street.
gettingAround: From the airport, take a shuttle, a taxi, or a ride-hail. Po Nagar is about 2 km north. The cable to Hòn Tre measures 3,320 m. The bay is given as about 507 km² and also as 249.65 km².

The railway puts Nha Trang at km 1315 from Hà Nội and km 411 from Sài Gòn. Southbound from Hà Nội the five trains run 24 hours 57 minutes to 28 hours 3 minutes. Southbound from Đà Nẵng is 9 hours 13 minutes to 11 hours. Northbound to Đà Nẵng is 9 hours 30 minutes to 11 hours 1 minute. Southbound to Sài Gòn is 7 hours 48 minutes to 10 hours 23 minutes. Northbound from Sài Gòn is 7 hours 16 minutes to 8 hours 43 minutes. Southbound from Tuy Hòa is 2 hours 4 minutes to 2 hours 44 minutes. Northbound to Tuy Hòa is 2 hours 6 minutes to 2 hours 19 minutes on four trains. A fifth northbound train does not list Tuy Hòa.

stayAreas.name: Trần Phú
stayAreas.summary: The city sand and the hotel row. The night market is behind 46 Trần Phú.

eat: Start with nem nướng from Ninh Hòa, bún cá from Ninh Hòa, and bánh căn, the clay-mold rice cake with squid, shrimp, or egg. The night-market stalls sit behind 46 Trần Phú.

Chợ Đầm and Chợ Xóm Mới, at 49 Ngô Gia Tự, carry the market bowls, including gỏi cá mai and bánh canh cá dầm. Yến sào comes from the nest islands, Hòn Nội and Yến Island. Vinpearl Harbour, the two Vincom plazas, and Nha Trang Center hold the restaurant rooms. Seafood is the dinner along the bay.
interestsBody: Swim or walk Trần Phú, then eat nem nướng and bún cá. Cross to Hòn Tre, or snorkel and dive at Hòn Mun. Climb to Po Nagar and the white Buddha while the light holds.
The night is the sand and the walking street behind 46 Trần Phú. For a family night on the island, Vinpearl Resort and Spa Nha Trang Bay sits on Hòn Tre, and the cable is the crossing.

faqs.a: Vietnam Tourism and the tourism bureau both print a dry season from January to August and rain from September to December. The tourism bureau prints an average of 26°C. A storm-closure calendar was not printed.
The AIP says Cam Ranh is 27 km from the centre of Nha Trang, with the city to the north. Vietnam Tourism says about 30 km south. The ride in minutes was not printed.

faqs.q: What are the Po Nagar hours and the ticket?
faqs.a: The provincial digital guide prints 06:00–17:30 and no ticket. The provincial tourism department prints 08:00–18:00 and 22,000 VND a person a visit. From 6 to 11 May 2026 Khánh Hòa police print free entry for the festival.

season.label: January to August
season.note: Vietnam Tourism and the tourism bureau both call January to August the dry season and September to December the rainy season. The tourism bureau prints an average of 26°C for the bay. The 2025 sea cultural-tourism festival ran 7 June–9 July. A 2026 sea-festival date was not printed. The heritage department puts Po Nagar’s annual festival at lunar 20–23 of month 3. The 2026 police notice prints 6–11 May, lunar 19–25.
